calculation.description: Twenty-day momentum scaled by the ten-day directional efficiency ratio; favors persistent trends over choppy moves.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC positive in 2020-2022 (+0.036841, 754 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.028612, 516), and 2025-2027 (+0.016607, 574). Small 15-asset cross-section; dates with at least 8 valid instruments used. Signal artifact: scripts/miner_3_20270325_range_efficiency_momentum_signal.csv
